title: Tech Note: New Log Parser
author: Timothy Aaron Penner, Senior Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: The Request Log and Debug Log file formats documented here (and the v16 R5 process-ID correlation field) remain part of 4D's diagnostic toolkit today, so the underlying knowledge is still useful, though the standalone log parser tool itself is a point-in-time utility that has likely been superseded by 4D's later built-in Analyzer/Debugger improvements and modern log tooling.
related_updates: 4D later improved built-in log viewing/analysis tooling in subsequent releases
Debug log and request log formats have continued to evolve across v17-v20 with additional fields
